practice.website_identity: patient-facing practice microsite hosted on the GTD domain; no separate live public practice domain found during this pass

investigation.method: manual review of live practice pages with NHS profile and search-result cross-checks

headline: Droylsden Medical Practice looks like another GTD Concrete CMS plus PATCHS site, but the appointments page is a bit sloppier than some: it explicitly says the form is available Monday to Friday from 7:30am, without making the cut-off nearly as clear as Guide Bridge or The Smithy.

live_stack.label: Patient-facing website stack
live_stack.platform: GTD-hosted practice microsite on concrete5 / Concrete CMS
evidence: The page exposes a concrete5 generator tag.
Search and NHS-profile checks did not surface a separate live practice domain; this GTD URL appears to be the patient-facing microsite.

live_stack.label: Current online request platform
evidence: The page tells NHS App users to continue to Patchs Health.

current_routes.label: PATCHS direct route
notes: The appointments page presents PATCHS as the online request form for appointments.
The page says the form is available Monday to Friday from 7:30am, but the captured wording does not make the end point equally clear.

current_routes.label: NHS App route
notes: The page tells NHS App users to continue to Patchs Health.

current_routes.label: Phone route
current_routes.kind: staff-assisted intake, not a distinct digital platform
notes: The page lists phone as another way to request an appointment.
The broader copy still makes PATCHS look like the underlying workflow.

current_routes.label: Prescriptions
notes: The prescriptions page points patients to their NHS account and also mentions the practice email address gmicb-tameside.droylsdenmedical@nhs.net.

complaints_and_feedback.headline: Complaints information is embedded in the contact-us page.

items.label: Complaints via contact-us page
notes: The page says patients should raise concerns with the practice manager first or contact the complaints team directly.
It lists GTD complaints contact details including gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

stale_or_conflicting_signals.label: Request window is underspecified
notes: The appointments page clearly states the 7:30am start for the form but does not present the cut-off as cleanly as some of the other GTD sites.

probably_true: PATCHS is the current patient-facing request platform here.
The public wording is a little less precise about request availability than several of the other GTD microsites.
needs_follow_up: The actual live cut-off time for Droylsden's PATCHS intake window.
